Full-bleed opaque dark painted square background, no outer border, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. A simple large subject filling the tile, high contrast silhouette, very little scenery, instantly recognizable when reduced to 60x60 pixels. Preserve soft rounded shapes, expressive eyes, warm highlights and rich dark colors. AUTOMATIC ATTACK: close-up head portrait of ONE adorable black dragon, charcoal-black scales, warm amber eyes, two small curved ivory horns, rounded broad snout and a gently confident alert expression. Mouth closed with just a tiny friendly fang visible. Head centered and unobscured. TWO broad GOLDEN curved arrows form a clear circular cycling ring around the dragon head. GOLD arrows, visible arrowheads, not green. Dark emerald background with cool rim light separating black scales. No body or other creatures.
